_README: REVIEWED completion claims. NO EMPTY STATE MAY CLAIM THE WORK IS DONE (owner
2026-08-17): a screen that got back nothing may say what it LOOKED FOR, never
what is TRUE OF THE BUSINESS. backend/scripts/check-empty-state-claims.mjs
finds claim-SHAPED strings; a regex cannot read meaning, so this file is where
a person records the judgement. Every entry needs a `why` that would survive
being read out loud. A string not listed here FAILS the build - that is the
whole point: silence becomes a decision.
Keyed by (file, normalized line text) and NOT by line number, so a merge that
moves a string keeps its review and an EDIT to a string re-opens it.
Entries whose string is gone are reported as STALE and printed, never failed -
a gate that punishes somebody for fixing a string is a gate that stops fixes.
The recurring legitimate case, so it does not have to be re-derived: a claim
tied to a NAMED document whose lines the server COUNTED is evidence, not
An absence is never evidence, however many documents it covers.
